scripts.test:stage: dotenvx run -f env/.env.stage -- npx playwright test
scripts.test:prod: dotenvx run -f env/.env.prod -- npx playwright test
scripts.test:ui: dotenvx run -f env/.env.stage -- npx playwright test --ui
scripts.allure:clear: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['allure-results', 'allure-report'].forEach(p => fs.existsSync(p) && fs.rmSync(p, {recursive: true, force: true}))"
scripts.test:allure: npm run allure:clear && npm run test:stage & npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
